title: Hypothesis: balancing manga translation quality with strictly local processing remains difficult on modest devices
summary: Tools document local and cloud options, but the quality/hardware/privacy tradeoff has not been benchmarked on shared permitted pages; do not infer lack of a good solution.
verification_plan: Use the same authorized multilingual manga pages on 8GB/12GB/24GB VRAM tiers; compare local OCR and translation quality, edits needed, speed, outgoing traffic and memory limits.
